species.real: Nobody has ever watched European eels spawn or caught an adult in the Sargasso Sea; we only know they breed there because the tiniest larvae turn up there and nowhere else.
species.name: Elverlet

dex.text: Slips through the river mud like a wet thought. Does not need a map, only a very long journey.
dex.fact: European eels spawn in the Sargasso Sea, and the young drift back across the Atlantic, arriving as see-through glass eels.

species.real: The South American electric eel is not an eel at all but a knifefish, nearer to catfish and carp, and it can give a shock of several hundred volts.
species.name: Severnshock

dex.text: Rumbles up the estuary with a grin and an electrical temper. Always takes the long way home.
dex.fact: Adult European eels swim thousands of kilometres to the Sargasso Sea to spawn, and scientists think it is a one-way trip.
